import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static long[][] C;
    static int R, Cc;
    static long tot;
    static long best = Long.MAX_VALUE;
    static long best_z = -1;
    static char[] s;
    static int[] cntA, cntB;
    static Map<Key, Long> mp = new HashMap<>();

    static class Key {
        long x;
        int v1, v2;
        Key(long x, int v1, int v2) {
            this.x = x;
            this.v1 = v1;
            this.v2 = v2;
        }
        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (this == o) return true;
            if (o == null || getClass() != o.getClass()) return false;
            Key key = (Key) o;
            return x == key.x && v1 == key.v1 && v2 == key.v2;
        }
        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return Objects.hash(x, v1, v2);
        }
    }

    static void dfs(long x, long y, int v1, int v2) {
        long diff = Math.abs(x - y);
        if (best <= 1 || diff - C[v1][R] * C[v2][R] >= best) return;
        if (v1 == R - 1 && v2 == R - 1) {
            diff = Math.abs(x - y);
            if (diff < best) {
                best = diff;
                best_z = x;
            }
            return;
        }
        if (v1 >= R) {
            long cur1 = C[v1][R] - C[v1 - 1][R];
            long sum2 = C[v2][R];
            dfs(x, y + cur1 * sum2, v1 - 1, v2);
        }
        if (v2 >= R) {
            long sum1 = C[v1][R];
            long cur2 = C[v2][R] - C[v2 - 1][R];
            dfs(x + sum1 * cur2, y, v1, v2 - 1);
        }
    }

    static long solve(long x, long y, int v1, int v2) {
        Key key = new Key(x, v1, v2);
        Long cached = mp.get(key);
        if (cached != null) return cached;
        long diff = Math.abs(x - y);
        if (diff - C[v1][R] * C[v2][R] > best) {
            mp.put(key, 0L);
            return 0;
        }
        if (v1 < R || v2 < R) {
            if (v1 >= cntA[v1 + v2] && v2 >= cntB[v1 + v2]) {
                int sum = v1 + v2;
                v1 -= cntA[sum];
                v2 -= cntB[sum];
                long res = C[v1 + v2][v1];
                mp.put(key, res);
                return res;
            }
            mp.put(key, 0L);
            return 0;
        }
        long res = 0;
        char c = s[v1 + v2 - 1];
        if (c != 'B') {
            long cur1 = C[v1][R] - C[v1 - 1][R];
            long sum2 = C[v2][R];
            res += solve(x, y + cur1 * sum2, v1 - 1, v2);
        }
        if (c != 'A') {
            long sum1 = C[v1][R];
            long cur2 = C[v2][R] - C[v2 - 1][R];
            res += solve(x + sum1 * cur2, y, v1, v2 - 1);
        }
        mp.put(key, res);
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        R = scanner.nextInt();
        Cc = scanner.nextInt();
        int maxN = 2 * (R + Cc);
        C = new long[maxN + 1][maxN + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= maxN; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= maxN; j++) {
                if (j == 0) C[i][j] = 1;
                else if (i == 0) C[i][j] = 0;
                else C[i][j] = C[i - 1][j] + C[i - 1][j - 1];
            }
        }
        tot = C[R + Cc][R] * C[R + Cc][R];
        {
            long x = 0, y = 0;
            int v1 = R + Cc, v2 = R + Cc;
            while (v1 >= R && v2 >= R) {
                if (x > y) {
                    long cur1 = C[v1][R] - C[v1 - 1][R];
                    long sum2 = C[v2][R];
                    y += cur1 * sum2;
                    v1--;
                } else {
                    long sum1 = C[v1][R];
                    long cur2 = C[v2][R] - C[v2 - 1][R];
                    x += sum1 * cur2;
                    v2--;
                }
            }
            best = Math.abs(x - y);
        }
        dfs(0, 0, R + Cc, R + Cc);
        s = scanner.next().toCharArray();
        int len = 2 * (R + Cc);
        cntA = new int[len + 1];
        cntB = new int[len + 1];
        cntA[0] = 0;
        cntB[0] = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            cntA[i + 1] = cntA[i] + (s[i] == 'A' ? 1 : 0);
            cntB[i + 1] = cntB[i] + (s[i] == 'B' ? 1 : 0);
        }
        long ans = solve(0, 0, R + Cc, R + Cc);
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
